ANCLA COTIDIANA: Caminar acompañado y abrigarse.
COMPORTAMIENTO IMPOSIBLE: Una caverna permite atravesar por debajo la extensión del mar.
EFECTO EN EL RELATO: Cruzar a otro dominio depende del cuidado y conocimiento de ella.
QUIÉN ACTÚA Y QUÉ NO CONTROLA EL HUMANO: Ella guía y abriga; él la sigue.

CONTRADICCIÓN QUE DEBE VERSE: ¿La pareja es pequeña y camina bajo el mar, con ella guiando y compartiendo abrigo?

Escena: 16:9 EXTREME WIDE distant slightly elevated SIDE VIEW. Vast cold cave passing UNDER an entire sea. Couple very small, each at most 125 PIXELS TALL on this 864-pixel-high canvas; place them at x73–82%, y58–73%. No human in foreground or center. Woman in front faces RIGHT and gently leads man behind: her LEFT hand reaches BACK and visibly HOLDS his right HAND between them, not a cloth edge. An INDIGO outer mantle remains over HER shoulders and extends loosely BACK over HIS shoulders as a shared cover. Under it her plain long WINE-RED manta, cream pechera and black braids visible; man blue Kotin, cream sleeves, sand tied headcloth, charcoal lower garment, red sash and dark sandals. NO embroidered borders or gold decorative symbols. Small brown faces are almost flat silhouette profiles with no cheek planes. Dry walking ground continues across full lower image. Enormous gray-blue and muted ochre rock vaults as six to eight broad separated paper sheets recede to far-right distance. ABOVE them at top quarter, broad teal paper wave strata show the sea continuing across entire canvas, visibly ABOVE roof of passage. Cold small matte paper drops under cave vault at right. LEFT 65% and BOTTOM QUARTER quiet dark rock and ground with no people for website text. The magical relationship is crossing a whole sea beneath its weight while she shelters him. Blue sea, rock and ground all broad matte cut paper, physically separated layers casting shadows, no printed texture, no real water or sand. Internal cut edges but no outer cardboard, stage base, floating island or diagram frame. Maintain cave-under-sea composition, make people more distant and enforce handholding plus shared mantle. No bird, butterfly, horse, boat, stars or ghost.

Tratamiento: Immersive full-bleed world constructed ENTIRELY from matte dyed CUT PAPER. Scenery consists of broad sheets physically separated at several distances, with air gaps, occlusion and cast shadows. Characters are almost-flat side-profile cutouts with natural adult proportions, one small eye incision and nose in outline, no modeled cheekbones. Clothing consists of broad folded paper pieces, never realistic fabric or skin. Internal fine cut edges visible, NO exterior cardboard backing, stage edge, base, pedestal, tabletop, picture frame or model island. Ground and water must also be paper.

Continuidad: Ulépala adulto marrón con cabello negro y pañuelo arena, Kotin azul índigo hasta debajo de rodillas sobre camisa crema de mangas, prenda inferior carbón, faja roja y sandalias oscuras. Recorte plano, perfil mínimo. Cada orientación conserva sólo su propio reparto y episodio; no importar objetos de otras piezas. Colores y puesta en escena son continuidad editorial, no uniformes históricos o códigos de clan.

Color y luz: Índigo, azul petróleo y ocre apagado; vino tinto y rojo bermellón como acentos específicos, crema y verde hoja. Papel mate y luz lateral, no resplandor.

Licencia visual editorial: La caverna y el abrigo están narrados. Ver simultáneamente mar y paso subterráneo es una traducción espacial editorial, no un plano geográfico.

Control de lectura: ¿La pareja es pequeña y camina bajo el mar, con ella guiando y compartiendo abrigo?

Evitar: Pixar, Disney, big cartoon eyes, sculpted face, photorealistic skin, close-up; bare torso, loincloth-only costume, invented sacred glyphs, feather crown; blood, wounds, corpse, sexual action, attack, neck injury, weapons; white ghost, magic portal, decorative moon, stars, butterfly, boat; cardboard base, outer frame, pedestal, diorama island, real sand or water.

Generous empty field all around; lateral soft light reveals shadow under wing and between broad tail feathers. No landscape, clouds, drops, musical notes, text, logo, hand or extra birds.
